response.text: Some further checks: SRC_REF on invoice journals, the unbalanced journal and the invoice-journal link, along with payment journals and the closed-period posting.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."STAT_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", (SELECT sum("DR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") dr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (1,2,141,589,802) ORDER BY 1

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"

SELECT p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_DT", p."PAY_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' ; ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" WHERE p."PAY_ID" IN (1,2,99) OR p."INV_ID"=141
